description: Source code for testing the run command API, including functions for executing commands, handling subprocesses, and running test suites with parallel execution and quoting stress tests.

methods.name: parallel_next
methods.description: Callback to get the next child process task, manages arguments and callback data.

methods.name: no_job
methods.description: Callback indicating no more jobs are available.

methods.name: test_divert_output
methods.description: Diverts output of a process to a file.

methods.name: task_finished
methods.description: Callback invoked when a task finishes, handles cleanup.

methods.name: task_finished_quiet
methods.description: Quiet version of task finished callback, just frees callback data.

methods.name: test_stdin_pipe_feed
methods.description: Feeds lines into stdin pipe for testing.

methods.name: next_test
methods.description: Provides the next test case from the test suite.

methods.name: test_failed
methods.description: Handles failure to start a test.

methods.name: testsuite
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests with parallel execution and pattern matching.

methods.name: quote_stress_test
methods.description: Performs quoting stress testing by spawning subprocesses with random arguments.

methods.name: inherit_handle
methods.description: Creates an inheritable handle for inter-process communication.

methods.name: inherit_handle_child
methods.description: Child process that reads from stdin and prints received data.

methods.name: cmd__run_command
methods.description: Main command handler for executing various run command tests and utilities.
